description: Japan open-core judicial baseline splits and contributory-negligence modifier heuristics for collision fault-ratio prediction (Issue #44). Baselines are conventional civil practice splits, not COLREGS statutory percentages.

modifiers.citation: Fog / restricted visibility (Rule 19 / 第19条 nuance): mutual reduced visibility often compresses the primary-side share (−10pp).
Night navigation lookout default: discretionary +10pp to the primary / give-way side.
Failure to maintain proper lookout (Rule 5 / 第5条): +10pp primary-side adjustment.
Radar available but unused / silent watchkeeping: +10pp primary-side adjustment.
Failure of required sound / warning signals: +5pp primary-side adjustment.
Narrow-channel / constrained-water maneuvering fault: +10pp primary-side adjustment.
Failure to proceed at a safe speed (Rule 6 / 第6条): +10pp primary-side adjustment.
Mutual / bilateral fault holding: compress primary-side share toward parity (−15pp).
